title: Counting to 10
seo_title: Counting to 10 – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Count objects up to 10; say how many; recognise small groups at a glance; match numbers to groups. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: count objects to 10, dice and ten frames, and how many at a glance. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Touch each one and say one number
key_sub: The last number you say tells how many.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Point to each thing and say one number.
  • Do not count a thing two times.
  • The last number you say is how many.

Examples

Example

Count the stars: ★ ★ ★ ★

1, 2, 3, 4

Answer: 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting one thing two timesTouch each thing only once.
Missing a thingCount in a line, from left to right.
Saying the numbers too fastOne number for each thing.

items.e: The last number Kayode says is 4. The last number tells how many. So there are 4 ducks. It is not 1. 1 is only the first one.
